about: cesr.encode cases: a code and a raw value in, the fully qualified encoding out, as hex bytes (the ASCII bytes of the Base64 text in the text domain; the qb2 bytes in the binary domain). One case per code size the master table uses: 1-, 2- and 4-character codes, with pad sizes 1, 2 and 0. Raw values are SHAKE-256 of the label unless hex is given.

cases.title: Encode an Ed25519 verification key in the text domain
cases.description: Code D, a 32-byte raw value. 32 mod 3 = 2, so the pad size is 1: one zero lead byte is prepended before Base64 conversion and the single zero character that results is replaced by the one-character code, giving 44 characters with the value right aligned.

cases.title: Encode an Ed25519 verification key in the binary domain
cases.description: The same code and raw value as CESR-0001 in the binary domain, which is the naive Base64 decoding of the text-domain primitive: 33 bytes whose first six bits are the code.

cases.title: Encode a Blake3-256 digest in the text domain
cases.description: Code E, a 32-byte digest, pad size 1, one-character code.

cases.title: Encode an Ed25519 signature in the text domain
cases.description: Code 0B, a 64-byte raw value. 64 mod 3 = 1, so the pad size is 2: two zero lead bytes are prepended and the two zero characters that result are replaced by the two-character code, giving 88 characters.

cases.title: Encode an Ed25519 signature in the binary domain
cases.description: The same code and raw value as CESR-0004 in the binary domain: 66 bytes.

cases.title: Encode a 128-bit salt in the text domain
cases.description: Code 0A, a 16-byte raw value, pad size 2, two-character code, 24 characters.

cases.title: Encode an ECDSA secp256k1 verification key in the text domain
cases.description: Code 1AAB, a 33-byte compressed public key. 33 mod 3 = 0, so there is no pad character to replace and the four-character code is prepended to the conversion, giving 48 characters.

cases.title: Encode an ECDSA secp256k1 verification key in the binary domain
cases.description: The same code and raw value as CESR-0007 in the binary domain: 36 bytes, of which the first three are the code.

cases.title: Encode an Ed448 verification key in the text domain
cases.description: Code 1AAD, a 57-byte key, pad size 0, four-character code prepended, 80 characters.

cases.title: Encode the specification's own short-number example in the text domain
cases.description: The worked example under 'Examples of pre-padding': ("M", 0x0001) encodes to "MAAB" in the text domain.

cases.title: Encode the specification's own short-number example in the binary domain
cases.description: The worked example under 'Examples of pre-padding': ("M", 0x0001) encodes to 0x300001 in the binary domain.
